description: CALL THIS FIRST to see which data sources are connected and have data. Returns connection status and record counts for: Shopify (always connected), Triple Whale, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, and YouTube. Use this to understand what data is available before making other queries. If a source shows 'not_connected', those tools will return empty results.
name: get_data_sources
